svg.text: D07 · F3 PREPARE THE RIVAL (A1 SUCCESS)

text.tspan: A1 success: named strategy, who chose it, description and taunt
The objective comes first, in plain words.
Difficulty with a plain-language note. Pilot: it defaults to
Medium, which new players may not notice.
Strategy name and "Strategy chosen by qwen3:4b-instruct":
the AI's decision is labelled as the AI's (T2).
Model-written taunt, with Hear it to play it in the rival's
The rival status chip stays visible on every menu screen.
